notes: Physique parameters of the master, as shape keys on its one topology (CHARACTER-SOURCE-001). A signed parameter drives its '_minus' key below zero and its '_plus' key above; 0 is the authored default (Olympic weightlifter), the middle of the range. Mass, development and definition are independent (PHYSIQUE-AXES-001): mass is overall muscular volume, the regional parameters are development, definition is how visible the transitions are (never volume). v2 targets: the sprinter (extreme_lean) and the bodybuilder-strongman (extreme_heavy) are the anchors, both more defined than the default; the keys are re-derived from the approved default before these values export (Gate 3). Nothing here moves a joint, scales a bone or changes physics.

parameters.reads: softer <- -> very defined (visibility of transitions, never volume)

head_profiles_notes: Physique-derived head morphology (HEAD-MORPH-001, character_modeling.head_profile): directional targets per configuration, shared parameters only (never identity), the skull restrained; provisional until calibrated on approved renders, and driving geometry only once the head shape keys exist (head milestone M3).
